اینج دھی علی دی ہوئی غریب اے

۱
جس بہن دے ویر ہوون اٹھارہ

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/mangdi-shimar-ton-zainab-rida-ay.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
head, body = original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
meta, roman = head.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
edits = {
'Mangdi Shimar toṅ Zainab rida ae': 'Mangdi Shimar toṅ Zainab ridaaeṅ',
'Rehya kaun baqi kis nu bulaaye': 'Rehya kaun baaqi kis nuṅ bulaaye',
'Jis bhain de veer hovan athara': 'Jis bhain de vir hovan athaara',
'Bachiya na koi Abid siwa ae': 'Bachiya na koi Aabid siwa ae',
'Bhul zakhm apne gayi hai Sakina': 'Bhul zakhm apne gayi ae Sakina',
'Maqtal jo aayi ohde waal khul gaye': 'Maqtal choṅ aayi ohde waal khul gaye',
'Darbaar aaya ohnu veer bhul gaye': 'Darbaar aaya ohnuṅ vir bhul gaye',
'Kardi maran di Zainab dua ae': 'Kardi maran di Zainab dua ae',
'Zainab Sakina nu gal naal la ae': 'Zainab Sakina nuṅ gal naal la ae',
'Pehli waar Zainab jad Kufe aayi': 'Pehli waar Zainab jadoṅ Kufe aayi',
'Veeraṅ da saaya babe di shahi': 'Viraṅ da saaya babe di shaahi',
'Nayi bhain kithe madfan di ja ae': 'Naiṅ bhain kite madfan di ja ae',
'Masruf hath hin lut gayi rida ae': 'Masruf hath hin lut gayi rida ae',
'Amari de vaangoṅ zulfaṅ nu dhondi': 'Amaari de vaangoṅ zulfaṅ nuṅ dhondi',
'Haalaat safraaṅ de maaṅ nu suna ke': 'Haalaat safraaṅ de maaṅ nuṅ suna ke',
}
lines = roman.split('\\n')
for before, after in edits.items():
    assert lines.count('  ' + before) == 1, before
    lines[lines.index('  ' + before)] = '  ' + after
updated = (meta + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join(lines)).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
p.write_bytes(updated)
verified_head, verified_body = p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
assert verified_body == body
assert verified_head.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == meta
source_blocks = verified_body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = verified_head.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in source_blocks] == [len(b.splitlines()) for b in roman_blocks] == [4] * 10
assert all(s.splitlines()[0] == chr(0x6f0 + i) and r.splitlines()[0].strip() == str(i) for i, (s, r) in enumerate(zip(source_blocks, roman_blocks)) if i)
print(f'Checked 31 verses across the opening and nine numbered stanzas. Updated {sum(a "'!= b for a, b in edits.items())} Roman lines.'"')
PY"

item.text:
Audited all 31 verses across the opening and nine stanzas. Corrected 13 Roman lines, including `choṅ` for چوں, `jadoṅ` for جدوں, and `nuṅ` for نوں. Verified stanza alignment and preserved the source text byte for byte.

The pronunciation of ہن in stanza 7 remains uncertain, so I retained `hin`. The verses use Shahmukhi Punjabi forms, while the metadata lists Urdu. I left the metadata as supplied for this Roman-only audit.
